scope: Proposition 3.6 (Critical histories) of the manuscript “Essential Singularity of the Correlation Length in the Planar XY Model” (preprints/Essential-Singularity-of-the-Correlation-Length-in-the-Planar-XY-Model-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 216 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5630748347a3657a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 18. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The fixed parameters and entry threshold can be chosen so that there is a family H(k) at b = bc, with admissible sk ≍ 2k and entry indices j0(k) = O(k), having the following properties. For every fixed 0 < c < c′ < 3, uniformly on c2k ≤ j ≤ c′2k, W (k) j = (1, 1) j + O  log(2 + j) j2  , ∥Q (k) j ∥ + ∥R (k) j ∥ = O(j−2 ). (3.34) The separately initialized torus remainders also satisfy O(j−2) on these stage ranges behind every valid later stop in the same history up to 4 · 2k. More generally, for any prescribed sufficiently small tube and any integer bound Jmax(s) = o(s2), the critical plane history at an admissible side s stays in that tube through Jmax(s), for all large s. Every stage of its separately initialized tori with valid stops below Jmax(s) stays in the corresponding small ball. The choices of geometric parameters are independent of s and Jmax.
